original_test_intent: Verify each SMBIOS Type 9 System Slot Length enum matches the approved slot-length category for the exact board/riser slot and persists after reboot; it describes firmware metadata and does not by itself prove clearance for a particular adapter.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 9 records, preserve the raw length enum with designation, slot ID, type, width and topology, compare against the board/riser mechanical specification, then repeat after an approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the versioned slot-length map and reboot plan. Measuring clearance or installing an adapter is optional separate work, not required for the stated metadata check.
required_inputs: Expected raw/decoded Slot Length per exact Type 9 identity
Board/riser/chassis revision and mechanical slot map
Applicable SMBIOS version and length-enum definitions
Policy for Other/Unknown/vendor values and relation to slot type
Validated parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS collection; do not insert/remove cards or open the chassis for this case.
Preserve raw enum and complete record identity because generic Short/Long labels can repeat across slots and decoder support can differ.
Do not infer full adapter fit, chassis clearance, retention support or power capability from the Slot Length field.
Check consistency with slot type and platform mechanical map without substituting an installed card's form factor.
Stop on unsupported enum, topology mismatch, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode each Type 9 length enum using the applicable SMBIOS version and compare it to the exact slot/mechanical map before and after reboot.
Do not perform physical fit testing or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the board/riser/chassis length map and exception handling.
Approve reboot/recovery, authorize separate physical-fit evidence if desired, and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field selector is relevant, but grep-only output omits raw enum and exact slot identity and cannot establish physical clearance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 9 records and compare the raw Slot Length enum per slot ID/designation against the versioned board/riser mechanical map before and after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The System Slot Length scope, Type 9 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate raw and decoded Slot Length against the applicable SMBIOS enumeration and exact platform mechanical map while treating adapter fit/clearance as separately scoped evidence.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, board/riser/chassis and dmidecode/parser versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 9 Slot Length enumeration, approved platform mechanical specification and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw-enum/version provenance, exact topology identity and an explicit boundary against physical-fit claims.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; improves metadata accuracy while avoiding an unsupported physical compatibility conclusion.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Versioned mechanical slot map and enum exception policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The metadata category cannot prove real chassis clearance, retention, cooling or power suitability for an adapter.

project_override_considerations: A project may define alternate length values for different risers/chassis, but must version the override by exact topology; a card-specific fit decision remains separate.
expected_evidence: Approved board/riser/chassis revisions, per-slot length map, SMBIOS version and exception policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 9 records with handle, designation, slot ID, raw/decoded length, type and width
Per-slot mechanical-map comparison without physical-fit claims
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot record diff
Engineer verdict; optional measurement/fit evidence separately identified

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define a Slot Length metadata correctness and persistence check.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The enum can be safely decoded and compared after a project map is supplied; optional physical fit is not core scope.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw enum, version, exact topology and physical-fit limitation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps the metadata-versus-physical boundary while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Treats the owner map and reboot approval as readiness inputs rather than PARTIAL execution.

review_improvement: Prevents a decoded Short/Long word from being accepted without exact slot attribution and prevents that metadata from being overstated as adapter-fit proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: System Slot Length is a discrete SMBIOS enum; version-aware comparison to an approved mechanical map is automatable and does not require chassis access.
